title: Nashville Townhome. Mins to Broadway. City Escape
description:
Experience Nashville from a spacious 3-story townhome just minutes from the heart of the city! 🎸 Perfect for families, groups & weekend getaways, this home puts you close to Broadway, Midtown, Germantown, local restaurants, live music & Nashville’s top attractions. Enjoy convenient parking, high-speed WiFi, a fully equipped kitchen, in-unit laundry & all the essentials for a comfortable Music City stay. 🤠✨

The space
Spread out across three spacious levels designed for groups, families, and friends traveling together. With 3 bedrooms, 7 beds, and room for up to 10 guests, everyone has space to settle in and enjoy Nashville comfortably.

The home features a fully equipped kitchen for cooking and gathering, comfortable living spaces, Smart TVs, high-speed WiFi, and everything you need for a weekend or extended stay.

★ 3-story townhome
★ 3 bedrooms · 7 beds
★ Sleeps up to 10 guests
★ Fully equipped kitchen
★ Comfortable living & dining areas
★ High-speed WiFi
★ Smart TVs
★ In-unit washer & dryer
★ Convenient parking
★ Central A/C & heat
★ Fresh linens & towels
★ Bathroom & kitchen essentials
★ Easy self check-in

Whether you're coming to Nashville for live music, a family trip, sporting event, work, or a weekend with friends, this home gives your group plenty of room to relax between adventures.

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire 3-story townhome throughout their stay, including all bedrooms, bathrooms, living areas, kitchen, and in-unit laundry.

★ Private access to the entire home
★ Convenient self check-in
★ Parking available
★ Full kitchen
★ Washer & dryer
★ High-speed WiFi

Check-in instructions and your unique access information will be sent before arrival for an easy, hassle-free check-in.
